Title: Patch 15.0 — New hero: Cho'gall New battleground (PTR): Towers of Doom Sc...
Subtitle: PTR patch notes (November 11, 2015, article 19953593) introducing Towers of Doom PTR playtesting, percentage-based scaling and respawn timer updates, score screen Kills/Assists split, Gathering Power changes, and balance updates for Falstad, Jaina, Zeratul, Kharazim, Uther, Leoric, and Rexxar.
Affected: Zeratul Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines (Removed for rework)
Highlights: PTR patch notes (November 11, 2015, article 19953593) introducing Towers of Doom PTR playtesting, percentage-based scaling and respawn timer updates, score screen Kills/Assists split, Gathering Power changes, and balance updates for Falstad, Jaina, Zeratul, Kharazim, Uther, Leoric, and Rexxar.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  • Scaling Changes: Health and damage scaling for all Heroes, Battleground Events, Minions, and Mercenaries changed from flat, additive values to multiplicative percentages; a large portion of total scaling previously gained over a match was added to Heroes' base values.
  • Respawn timers increased for levels 1–10.
  • Attack Speed Slows now apply only to Heroes and Summons.
  • Several tooltips updated with exact details (such as delays and charges gained).
  • Art & Visuals:
  • - Tower targeting ring size reduced by 50%.
  • - Artanis walk animations improved and Stitches given additional facial animation polish.
  • - Visual polish added for Magni Muradin's Storm Bolt (Q) and Attack Speed Slow visual effects on Heroes affected by the Imposing Presence talent.
  • User Interface:
  • - Party and game invitation pop-ups now display the inviting player's portrait frame.
  • - In-Game Score Screen (TAB): XP column removed; Takedown column split into Kills (final blow on an enemy Hero) and Assists (nearby allies when an enemy Hero dies).
  • - Minimap now visually indicates when allied Heroes use Hearthstone, and a chat message displays when an ally activates Hearthstone.
  • Talents:
  • - Gathering Power: Hero takedowns now grant 2% Ability Power per kill up to a maximum of 30%, with all stacks lost upon death.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could match a team without Support Heroes against a team with Support Heroes in Quick Match.
  • Fixed an issue where Auto-Select could occasionally fail to assign a Support Hero to teams lacking Supports.
  • Fixed an issue causing French AZERTY keyboards to revert to QWERTY hotkeys.
  • Fixed a bug that could cause Stealthed Heroes to fire a Basic Attack at a nearby enemy immediately after Mounting.
  • Legendary and Epic Hero Skins are now properly labeled on the Hero Select screen.
  • Fixed an issue preventing mouse-wheel scrolling through the Friends List while browsing the Shop.
  • Players in Hero League draft lobbies can no longer be invited to join a Real-ID friend's party.

=== Battlegrounds ===
[Updates]
  • Towers of Doom:
  • - Cores are protected by an indestructible barrier; teams capture periodic Altars so controlled Bell Towers fire payloads at the opposing Core.
  • - Destroying a Bell Tower causes it to respawn after a short delay aligned with the capturing team and grants an additional payload in Altar volleys.
  • - Available as the sole Battleground in PTR matchmaking queues during playtesting through November 24 (not live immediately on patch day).
[Bug Fixes]
  • Updated the Plant Terror's Overgrowth tooltip so it no longer states that it does not disable the enemy Core.
  • Fixed an issue preventing Hero vision radiuses from displaying on the Infernal Shrines and Battlefield of Eternity minimaps.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Abathur can no longer capture objectives at his body's location while using Ultimate Evolution.
  • Adrenal Overload now properly increases Monstrosity's attack speed while under the effects of Symbiote.
  • Ultimate Evolution Clones and Monstrosities now properly receive benefits from Volatile Mutation if selected after a Summon is already active.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heroes with Relentless that become Polymorphed will now properly receive damage from Brightwing's Unstable Anomaly talent when Polymorph expires.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Chen's Spirit forms will now properly leave Stealth after casting an Ability during Storm, Earth, Fire.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heroes simultaneously struck by Diablo's Overpower and Stitches' Hook will no longer be thrown outside the playable area.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  • Conjurer's Pursuit and Gathering Power talents removed.
  • Hammerang (Q):
  • - Power Throw talent moved from Level 1 to Level 4.
  • - New Level 1 Talent — Gathering Storm: Permanently increases Hammerang's damage by 1 each time it damages an enemy Hero.
  • Flow Rider (Talent):
  • - No longer reduces Barrel Roll's cooldown.
  • - Now causes Basic Abilities to recharge 100% faster while Tailwind is active.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Updates]
  • Frostbite (Trait):
  • - Deep Chill (Talent): Movement Speed slow bonus from Chill reduced from 35% to 30%.

=== Heroes: Kael'thas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Damage-over-time previews for Living Bomb now more accurately reflect burst damage amounts at the end of the effect.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Ravage cooldown now properly resets when used to destroy an enemy Structure.

=== Heroes: Kharazim ===
[Updates]
  • Insight (Trait): Mana regeneration on every third hit increased from 12 (+0.21 per level) to 14 (+0.36 per level).
  • Iron Fists (Trait): Bonus damage on every third hit increased from 100% to 125%.
  • Divine Palm: Visual effects for Butcher's Brand no longer persist on targets protected from death by Divine Palm.

=== Heroes: Leoric ===
[Updates]
  • Drain Hope (W):
  • - Cooldown reduced from 12 to 11 seconds.
  • - Being stunned while casting Drain Hope no longer cancels the Ability, and the missile continues to travel.
  • - Damage dealt and Health gained reduced from 25% to 20%.
  • - Damage and healing now increase over time as a flat value.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could allow Leoric to change direction while using March of the Black King.

=== Heroes: Lt. Morales ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could cause a Medivac to persist on the battlefield if Lt. Morales died while casting Medivac Dropship.
  • Damage prevented by Safeguard now always displays in whole numbers.

=== Heroes: Rexxar ===
[Updates]
  • Misha (Trait / D):
  • - Misha's death timer portrait now appears in the death timer bar while respawning.
  • - Reduced how frequently Rexxar's voiceover plays when commanding Misha.
  • Misha, Fixate (1) renamed to Misha, Focus!.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Misha can now properly return to Rexxar if on the opposite side of an enemy Gate with an open path where a Wall was destroyed.

=== Heroes: Sonya ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Next Basic Attack after casting Ancient Spear now properly benefits from the Follow Through talent.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heroes activating Ice Block while simultaneously coming under the effects of Gorge now properly retain Ice Block's visual effects for its duration.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Heal-over-time previews for Shadowstalk now more accurately reflect burst healing amounts at the end of the effect.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Updates]
  • Eternal Devotion (Trait): Spirit form duration reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
  • Divine Shield (R): Cooldown increased from 70 to 90 seconds.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Updates]
  • Focused Attack talent removed.
  • New Level 4 Talent — Master Warp-Blade: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack against the same Hero deals 100% bonus damage.
